note: Shared pixel palette for FloraScape plant sprites. One character per pixel; '.' is transparent.

frameNotes.seed: Just the soil mound with a tiny seed or crack; plant not visible yet (may show 1-2 seed pixels).
frameNotes.sprout: Two tiny leaves just out of the soil.
frameNotes.young: Half-grown leafy plant, no fruit yet.
frameNotes.sway: Same as mature with leaves/stems shifted by 1px to suggest a breeze; alternates with mature as an idle loop.
